# Lab 20.4: Cloud Monitoring Dashboards & Alerts

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a Cloud Monitoring dashboard for BigQuery and an alert that fires when slot usage or failed queries go above a threshold.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Explore the metrics.** **Monitoring → Metrics explorer**. Search **BigQuery**. Try:
   - `bigquery.googleapis.com/slots/allocated_for_project`
   - `bigquery.googleapis.com/query/count`
   - `bigquery.googleapis.com/job/num_in_flight`

2. **[CLI] Create a dashboard.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

{
  "displayName": "BigQuery Lab Dashboard",
  "gridLayout": {"widgets": [
    {"title": "Slots allocated",
     "xyChart": {"dataSets": [{"timeSeriesQuery": {"timeSeriesFilter": {
        "filter": "metric.type=\"bigquery.googleapis.com/slots/allocated_for_project\"",
        "aggregation": {"alignmentPeriod": "60s", "perSeriesAligner": "ALIGN_MEAN"}}}}]}},
    {"title": "Queries in flight",
     "xyChart": {"dataSets": [{"timeSeriesQuery": {"timeSeriesFilter": {
        "filter": "metric.type=\"bigquery.googleapis.com/query/count\"",
        "aggregation": {"alignmentPeriod": "60s", "perSeriesAligner": "ALIGN_MEAN"}}}}]}}
  ]}
}
EOF
gcloud monitoring dashboards create --config-from-file=bq_dashboard.json</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Create an alert.** **Monitoring → Alerting → Create policy**:
   - **Metric**: BigQuery → Slots allocated for project
   - **Threshold**: above 500 for 5 minutes
   - **Notification channel**: your email

4. **[Console] Alert on failed jobs with logs.** **Logging → Logs Explorer**, filter:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

</div>

severity=ERROR</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Click **Create alert**, so you get an email when a job fails.

5. **[CLI] Trigger it.** Run a query that fails on purpose (`SELECT * FROM lab20.nope`) and wait for the email.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Dashboard | Slots and queries over time |
| Metric alert | High slot usage |
| Log alert | Failed jobs |
| Notification | Email |
